description.value: Second Beach Pool is a well-known outdoor public swimming pool located in Stanley Park near English Bay in Vancouver. It operates seasonally in summer and is a popular destination for families and visitors exploring the seawall. Touring cyclists riding the Stanley Park loop will find it a natural rest stop along one of BC's most scenic urban cycling routes.
